propositions: A standing eval spec for the code-review-concurrency overlay must be authored to prevent silent regression of recall/precision behavior against traced production race conditions.
The spec must define 2+ scored recall cases (expect: finding) distilled as minimal diff hunks from real bug-introducing commits, with provenance comments.
The spec must define 3+ scored no-fire cases (expect: pass) including a hard false-positive control (deliberate probe-then-skip with real lock), all with provenance comments.
R3 (fail-open guard case) must be present as a non-gating documented stretch—a commented hunk with provenance and rationale, not a scored case—so it cannot fail the gate by construction.

The spec must use epochs: 3, gate: at_least(2), deterministic scorers, and include a header comment stating coverage_threshold is a run-success floor and the only per-run tolerance is gate: at_least(2).
